title: On the non-existence of finite groups with certain normal subgroups
summary: Problem 20.21 of Mazurov and Khukhro (Unsolved Problems in Group Theory: The Kourovka Notebook, 20th Issue, 2022), contributed by M.~Conder and attributed to G.~Verret, asks whether there exists a finite group $G$ with two normal subgroups $K$ and $L$ of index $12$ such that $K \cong L$, but with non-isomorphic quotients $G/K \cong C_{12}$ and $G/L \cong A_4.$ We prove that no such finite group exists.
